decision: Certify TensorLBM cross-validation claims only through a machine-enforced, CI-executed assertion gate with an external anchor per case; a non-finite metric is always a failure.
alternatives: A: keep declarative cases only (thresholds in metadata, executed by hand) -- rejected: measured below, every case was unexecuted and one certified NaN as PASS
B: report aggregate tests-count / coverage percentage -- rejected: coverage does not assert accuracy
C (selected): pytest gate that runs the anchor cases and asserts each declared threshold, plus fail-closed non-finite semantics; CI job executes it on every push

metrics.eps_inf: max relative deviation of u(y) from the analytical Poiseuille profile
metrics.eps_L2: L2 relative deviation of the u(y) profile from analytical
metrics.l2_u/l2_v: L2 deviation of centerline u/u_lid, v/u_lid from Ghia et al. (1982) tabulated DNS
metrics.amplitude_rel_pct/phase_rel_pct: relative amplitude and phase error vs the Womersley/Sexl analytical phasor

acceptance.global: every metric whose declared threshold is an error measure must be <= 0.15 (owner standard)

stopping_rule: Stop and report honest FAIL for an arm as soon as its run yields a non-finite metric or exhausts its step budget; never replace a diverged run by a coarser/finer retry until the divergence is explained.

fast (CI, every push): cavity health arm n=33 x 120 steps (~1 s)

confounders: torch default thread pool is 128 on this host; the same Poiseuille case takes 9.9 s at 128 threads and 4.2 s at 1 thread -- wall-clock claims are only comparable at fixed thread count
dtype: cases run in float64; float32 would shift the 1e-8 mass-drift budget
architecture: CI runner and cluster nodes are loong64, the local control node is x86_64 -- timings are not portable, metrics are
repetition_rationale: LBM BGK/RLBM collision is deterministic (no RNG except the Womersley seeding), so a single run per configuration is the correct unit; reproducibility is asserted by SHA-256 state hash instead of repetition.
external_anchors: Poiseuille: u(y) = g/(2 nu) y (H-y) (Schlichting, Boundary-Layer Theory)
Guo, Zheng & Shi (2002) Phys. Rev. E 65:046308 (forcing scheme)
Ghia, Ghia & Shin (1982) J. Comput. Phys. 48:387-411 (lid-driven cavity DNS)
Womersley (1955) J. Physiol. 127:553; Sexl (1930) parallel-plate oscillatory flow
Longest & Vinay (2005) / Krueger et al. (2017) The Lattice Boltzmann Method (Zou-He BC, half-way bounce-back)
